providers.pricingNotes: Default VM $0.036/hour (4 vCPU, 8 GB, 50 GB). Flat rate for each size; Small, Large and Xlarge are also offered. $20 monthly minimum/packs excluded; billed per second.

Pro, iad1: active CPU $0.128 per vCPU-hour of CPU time (I/O wait not billed), memory $0.0212 per GB-hour of wall time in one-minute minimum increments, $0.60 per million creations. Vercel's docs leave rounding after the first minute open; we charge whole minutes, the dearer reading. Metered: the bench stops each sandbox to read Vercel's meter before deleting it, so the meter includes the stop's disk snapshot (about 3% in one probe; approximate, not corrected per task). Hourly assumes every vCPU busy. Pro's $20 credit, data transfer and snapshot storage excluded.

providers.pricingNotes: Sandbox rates ($0.1419 per CPU-hour, $0.024 per GiB-hour; one Modal CPU is a physical core). Billed per second on max(request, usage), minimum request 0.125 CPU. Priced on the requested allocation, never on the guest's MemTotal, which shows the host's memory without a size. A sized sandbox pins request = limit, so its estimate is exact. The default track (0.125 CPU, 128 MiB request) bursts into spare host capacity and that usage is billed too, so its estimate is a lower bound. A pinned region adds 1.15x (broad, such as us) or 1.75x (narrow, such as us-east). No disk charge or creation fee listed; plan credits excluded.

Published Sandboxes runtime rates ($0.0655/vCPU-hour, $0.0211/GB RAM-hour), priced on the allocation. Billing increment and minimum not stated; one-second estimate. Free promotional period excluded. Realistic build runs mount an 8 GiB volume (fix-and-test mounts none), priced at $0.16/GB-month for the sandbox's lifetime. Snapshots and stored images not used.

Published usage rates: $0.004/vCPU-hour and $0.00225/GiB-hour of memory, per second while running (not while starting, paused or stopped). Paid plans include disk (Builder 1 TiB across machines), beyond that $0.08/GiB-month; each machine's 20 GiB /data is counted as included. Plan fee and monthly credits ($20 Pro, $100 Builder) and egress ($0.02/GiB beyond the plan's) excluded. Default agent-browser template is 4 vCPU / 8 GiB.

Published Sandboxes rates on the Performance tier, the default ($0.05/vCPU-hour, $0.01/GiB RAM-hour), priced on the allocation and billed per millisecond while running (2026-11-18). Shared ($0.011, $0.0055) and Spot ($0.0063, $0.00135) tiers are cheaper and not used. Disk not billed. The snapshot tests did not run: Beam has no API to delete a memory snapshot. Credits excluded.
